author: Samsung
description:
Shared classroom displays can make it challenging for teachers to keep their own settings and content. Samsung AMS (Account Management Solution) helps teachers quickly access their personalized workspace with secure, seamless sign-in.

With a simple QR code or NFC-enabled ID card, educators can instantly access their files, apps, and preferences without entering passwords.

Hear from school IT administrators on how Samsung Education Portal simplifies account management, display enrollment, and Emergency Alert distribution through integrations with platforms like InformaCast and Raptor.

Learn more about Samsung display solutions: http://smsng.co/B2Bsolutions

#AccountManagementSolution #InteractiveDisplay #EdTech #Samsung
title: Interactive Display: Make Shared Classrooms Feel Personal with AMS | Samsung
